water_access.source_name: Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife
water_access.scope_note: Each record verifies only the named WDFW access facility; it does not declare an entire shoreline, river reach, road, or neighboring parcel public.

warnings: Recovery snapshot built from individually indexed official WDFW water-access-area pages because the bulk ArcGIS service was unavailable in the packaging environment.
This snapshot is a verified public-access baseline, not an exhaustive inventory of every WDFW site. The included GitHub workflow refreshes Washington from WDFW official data when run.
Coordinates and amenities were intentionally left blank unless explicitly present in the recovered official-page record; no locations or facilities were inferred.
